meaning: The portal has not switched product pictures on yet (answered after the sync key check, before the body is read).
tillDoes: Keeps its pictures, sends none, and asks again (GET sync/product-images) no sooner than Retry-After (3600 s), then at most once a day. Push and pull are unaffected.

meaning: The portal has no product with this id for the calling business (not pushed yet, deleted, or another business's). rejectedKey = the product id.
tillDoes: Keeps the picture waiting and sends it again after a push that carried the Product row; never more than once a day for the same product.

meaning: The body (Content-Length) is over 2 MB (2097152 bytes). rejectedKey = the product id.
tillDoes: Makes a smaller copy (≤ 2000 px, JPEG quality 85) and sends that; does not send the same bytes again.

meaning: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, or the Content-Type is not the type of the bytes. rejectedKey = the product id.
tillDoes: Converts the picture to JPEG and sends that; does not send the same bytes again.

meaning: X-SSPOS-Image-Sha256 is not the SHA-256 of the body: the upload was cut or changed on the way. rejectedKey = the product id.
tillDoes: Sends it again at the next run (same bytes, same hash).

meaning: Width or height is under 16 or over 2000 pixels. rejectedKey = the product id.
tillDoes: Sends a copy scaled to at most 2000 px on its longest side; a picture under 16 px is not sent.

meaning: The portal cannot read the picture (damaged file, animated WebP). rejectedKey = the product id.
tillDoes: Marks the product's picture as refused on Sync status; sends it again only when the picture changes.
